verdict.rationale: AFK's own docs describe a built-in AI that takes a goal, breaks it into tasks, and carries them forward, asking for a human decision only when needed. It also pre-fills forms from company context and can query and act across connected tools from one surface, with writes paused for sign-off. Delegation is clearly the product's core, but the evidence is only marketing-page claims. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detailed docs on how the assistant is used (chat or command interface, limits on task types).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Set a goal like "Get to $1m ARR" and AI decomposes it into tasks — revenue modeling, cohort analysis, KPI alerts, milestone tracking — and asks only when it needs a human decision.
It carries the process forward and asks when it needs a human decision.
AI pre-fills forms using context it already knows — your EIN, addresses, founder details. You confirm or correct.
Query and act across Mercury, Gusto, Carta, Stripe, and more from a single surface.
Reads run automatically. Writes pause for sign-off.
